verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions settling funds, sending payouts, dashboard reports and an MCP server. None of it documents an API for retrieving settlement or balance-transaction data, or for mapping each bank deposit to its underlying charges. Dashboard reports and the generic MCP bridge are adjacent features, not the reconciliation capability itself, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
